title: Teriyaki Fried Chicken
description: Crispy fried chicken tossed in a sweet and savory homemade teriyaki glaze.

steps.1: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and coat thoroughly in cornstarch.
steps.2: Heat oil to 350°F and fry chicken until golden brown and crispy. ?stopwatch-08:00?
steps.3: In a separate pan, combine soy sauce, mirin, sugar, and ginger. Simmer until thickened.
steps.4: Toss the crispy chicken in the sauce until evenly coated.
